audience.programmeDescription: Aerospace Engineering at Delft combines mathematics and physics with aerodynamics, structures, materials, propulsion, flight and space systems. Design projects, experiments, a minor and a final team design exercise connect these subjects.
audience.comparisonExplanation: A full UCR comparison is withheld while course-entry and final-project conditions for this curriculum are verified. UCR offers related study in mathematical systems, computing, robotics and energy, but no complete comparison or no-match conclusion is certified here.
